# PM007: task-without-story

> Generated: do not edit this page. Regenerate with `cargo dev gen rules`.

A task with user-visible scope has no parent story and no `no-story` reason.

A task whose scope reaches beyond docs, tests and tickets changes behavior a
user can see; that needs a story. Bugs and chores may stand alone.

## Remedy

Set a parent story with `frob ticket edit --parent STORY`, or label the task
`no-story` and state why in its body.

## Examples

### PM007 task without parent story / A user-visible task without a story fires #1 (line 8) (fire)

```text
task a scope=crates/frob/src/**
```

### PM007 task without parent story / A task under a story is clean #2 (line 14) (clean)

```text
story s
task a scope=crates/frob/src/** parent=s
```

### PM007 task without parent story / A task under an epic still fires #3 (line 21) (fire)

```text
epic e
task a scope=crates/frob/src/** parent=e
```

### PM007 task without parent story / A no-story reason is clean #4 (line 28) (clean)

```text
task a scope=crates/frob/src/** labels=no-story
```

### PM007 task without parent story / A docs-only task is clean #5 (line 34) (clean)

```text
task a scope=docs/**
```

### PM007 task without parent story / A task without scope is clean #6 (line 40) (clean)

```text
task a
```
